# Disposable v4 migration fixture

Generated by compiling the immutable pre-0071 Store captured in the baseline,
not current v5 DDL. Input is the existing captured-v3 synthetic library fixture.
The captured v4 implementation migrated it and added a no-audio manual session,
a note reference and a human correction. profiles remains v3; raw audio and jobs
come from the existing synthetic fixture. No operator data was read.

Generator source/lock and source hashes are recorded in provenance.json. The
original generator manifest points to the immutable target baseline; reproduction
requires that snapshot or a copy verified by the listed hashes.
